svg.font-family: Georgia,"Times New Roman","Liberation Serif",serif,"Hiragino Mincho ProN","Noto Serif JP","Yu Mincho","IPAMincho",serif
svg.title: Offset hatching in the left margin
svg.desc: Rows of short diagonal marks fill the left margin, each row shifted by half a step; the marks shorten and thin toward the text so the texture fades out. 425 marks, decoration only.
